nodes_update.note: Margaret Noble, b. Dungannon 28 Oct 1867; heard Vivekananda London Nov 1895; brahmacharini 25 March 1898; Bagbazar school 13 Nov 1898; d. Darjeeling Oct 1911 (12 or 13 Oct in sources). Sidebar added 7 Nov 2026.

edges_upsert.note: Sri Sarada Math lists Aurobindo Ghosh among those her writings and speeches inspired; no direct source read for a closer tie.
Encyclopedia.com and Sri Sarada Math say she influenced or inspired Tagore; the nature of the tie not checked.

places.name: Bagbazar, Calcutta
places.what: Girls' school opened 13 November 1898 in Bosepara Lane, inaugurated with Sarada Devi's blessing

glossary.def: A woman who has taken the vow of celibate religious study; Vivekananda gave Margaret Noble this status and the name Nivedita on 25 March 1898.

nivedita: Birth, family, schools, Sesame Club, Nov 1895, Jan 1898, 17 and 25 March 1898, 13 Nov 1898 school, plague 1899, works, artists, death 13 Oct 1911, epitaph -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sister_Nivedita

Bosepara Lane school, plague March 1899, art funding Ajanta/Ellora, 1902-04 lectures, will to Belur Math, influence on Tagore, Gokhale, Aurobindo; header dates 1868 conflict with 1867 -> https://www.srisaradamath.org/sisternivedita.php

Parents, Halifax, secretary to Geddes, 1903 Nivedita School (conflicts), Havell, Bose, death 12 Oct 1911 -> https://www.encyclopedia.com/women/encyclopedias-almanacs-transcripts-and-maps/nivedita-sister-1867-1911
